verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Segment/Engage lets marketers build Audiences from tracking events, traits, and computed traits, syncing to destinations (segment-docs-9, 32, 38, 23), which implies a no-code audience-building experience. However, there is no explicit mention of a visual drag-and-drop builder UI or of showing estimated audience size before activation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the visual/no-SQL builder interface and audience size estimation feature.
